chunks: Hammad narrated from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far عليه السلام about what is obligatory in the salat (prayer), and he said: “The time, taharah, the qiblah, the orientation, the ruku', the sujud, and the du'a.” I said: “What about what is other than that?” He said: “A sunnah (prophetic tradition) within an obligation.”

key_terms.الْفَرْضِ: that which is obligatory and legally required
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةُ: the direction of prayer toward the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْوَقْتُ: the prescribed time for the prayer
key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: a recommended prophetic practice within the obligatory act

ai.seo_question: What are the obligatory parts of salat (prayer) according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies the core obligatory elements of salat (prayer), naming its essential conditions and acts. It also distinguishes these from other components that are regarded as sunnah (prophetic tradition) within the obligatory prayer, showing a legal hierarchy within ritual practice.
